name: Wataridori ni Yadorigi o
source:
19th century European island country. 
Main character comes from a small and aims for a bit city. He meets two girls in the train and gets in good terms with them. After arriving to the city protagonist gets an offer to become a tutor of one of the girls. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在19世紀的一個歐洲島國。
主角來自小地方，一心向往大城市。他在火車上遇見兩名少女，並與她們相談甚歡。抵達城市後，主角就受邀擔任其中一人的家教。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
